Snoop Dogg, born Cordozar Calvin Broadus Junior in nineteen seventy-one, is a legendary American rapper, songwriter, record producer, television personality, and actor. He rose to fame in the nineteen nineties as a central figure in West Coast hip hop and gangsta rap, beginning with his debut album, Doggystyle. Beyond his music career, he is a multifaceted entrepreneur, a vocal advocate for cannabis legalization, and a prominent public figure known for his authentic and laid-back persona. He has also ventured into sports, including owning the Snoop Youth Football League and becoming a co-owner of the professional soccer club Swansea City in twenty twenty-five.
